MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The portable SSD would help me move files while complementing my desktop backup drive; it offers a different use from storage I already have.",
    "The Blink bundle feels like a useful extension of my door alarms and Alexa devices, while the HDMI switch could connect my Blu-ray player and Fire TV more conveniently. Both build on equipment I already use."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Another Fire TV stick and an older Echo Show feel redundant after my recent Fire TV 4K Max bundle, Echo Show 5, and matching stand purchases.",
    "The internal drives require an installation need and compatibility I have not established. My external drive history does not mean I am planning an internal upgrade.",
    "The headphones, five short charging cables, and separate microphone do not address a current need; my webcam already includes a microphone."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Buying Alexa devices seems to have been taken as a reason to suggest more of the same devices, even when I recently filled those needs.",
    "My interest in computer accessories and storage seems to have been stretched to cover electronics with very different purposes and installation requirements."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent purchases matter because they show which needs I have already addressed; buying the Echo Show stand suggests I am equipping that display rather than looking for another one.",
    "Useful additions depend on a specific role alongside my existing equipment, such as portable file storage, camera coverage, or switching television inputs. A related product alone is not enough."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The suggestions recognize my interest in practical electronics but sometimes confuse useful additions with redundant devices or upgrades I have no reason to make."
}
